name: kimodo-soma-rp-v1.1
note: Kimodo's text-to-motion checkpoint (people/clips.py MODEL), trained on Bones Rigplay 1, which NVIDIA licensed commercially; the licence allows commercial use (checked 2026-10-09). The SEED and SMPLX checkpoints are deliberately not used (#36).

name: llm2vec-llama3-mntp
note: Kimodo's text encoder, first adapter (the MNTP LoRA on Llama 3 8B Instruct). The adapter is MIT; as a derivative of Llama 3 it is used under the Llama 3 Community License too (checked 2026-10-09).

name: llm2vec-llama3-mntp-supervised
note: Kimodo's text encoder, second adapter (supervised contrastive LoRA); terms as the first adapter's.

name: llama3-8b-instruct
note: The base of Kimodo's text encoder. Gated: seeding needs the hf-read-token secret (Secret Manager, by name). Commercial use is allowed below 700 million monthly users, under Meta's Acceptable Use Policy, with 'Built with Meta Llama 3' shown where a product built with it is distributed (checked 2026-10-09). The 16 GB original/ consolidated checkpoint is not fetched.

name: soma-x-assets
note: SOMA-X's body model assets at tag v0.3.3 (the tag SOMA-X d6aa640 asks for in soma.assets.get_assets_dir); Apache-2.0, shape space from commercially licensed scans (checked 2026-10-09). Its SMPL, SMPLX and MANO folders hold only NVIDIA's wrap meshes for interoperability: the SMPL-family model files, whose licences forbid commercial use, are user-supplied, never fetched and never used here.

name: sam3dbody-cpp-onnx
note: SAM3DBody-cpp's shared and cuda profiles (vendor/sam3dbody-cpp/tools/fetch_model.sh, whose per-file sha256 these match). The repository is marked MIT, but the weights are converted from Meta's SAM 3D Body and stay under the SAM License, which allows commercial use, asks that publications acknowledge SAM, and forbids military, weapons and Trade-Control uses (checked 2026-10-09).
